Composition rights
Commons identifies Beethoven’s composition as public domain (PD-old-100). Documented

The composition’s status is separate from the rights in this orchestral performance.

Recording rights
Commons records a public-domain dedication by Skidmore College orchestra, with unrestricted fallback permission. Documented

Programme rule 1: the page’s Recording subsection applies PD-author to the performance, not merely PD-old-100 to the composition. Commons also carries an attribution-only permission; orchestra and Musopen credit are retained.
